Every other vector/opmask byte, complete GPR/flags/selectors/FP/kernel/live XSAVE, source image and outside-range memory remains exact. All input components are independently seeded non-init.
negative_endpoint: Eight genuine failed operations: aligned noaccess/read-only write #PF6/7, ordinary and indexed misaligned crossing #GP13/error0 with unchanged CR2 and all memory, indexed read-only, stack read-only, and aligned base/RIP source destinations. Each keeps exit125, zero TRACE, no store completion, full unchanged source and actual closure. PF memory is actual native/TF equal and each potentially written byte old or literal source; no atomicity claim.

scope: Exact Code1838 unmasked EVEX512.66.0F.W1 aligned store/reverse-copy. Original160 aligned family geometries plus exact observed62e1fd487f0f pair; no other store width/family. Old load and VEX128 store suites remain separately mandatory. The existing exact vpb_refused[16] and store_refused[5] bytes are now mandatory typed1847/RANGE64 observations, never skipped. All161 native cases and eight original failures remain required.
